triggering_hold.reason: No member of the original 50-70 Ry by 8-14 cubic k-mesh candidate matrix satisfied the unchanged 0.001 eV/atom equilibrium-energy criterion against the 80 Ry/16^3 holdout. The lattice criterion passed broadly, so the route stopped before any slab calculation.

anti_circularity.experimental_quarantine: No Na/Cu(001) adsorption, barrier, prefactor, rate, friction, linewidth, or turnover value may enter this extension.
anti_circularity.threshold_rule: The existing |delta a0| <= 0.005 A and |delta E0| <= 0.001 eV/atom thresholds are unchanged.
anti_circularity.failure_rule: If the high-cost reference fails its independent audit, or if no registered candidate passes against the audited reference, the result is HOLD. The reference and audit cannot select themselves.

selection_order.rule: smallest registered estimated computational cost among joint-pass candidates
